clinical_setting: Hereditary Breast & Ovarian Cancer Multidisciplinary Review

risk_classification.summary: Score 0.950 places variant in Calibration Bin 4 with 72.1% empirical PPV. Strongly indicated for RNA confirmation.

molecular_evaluation.primary_mechanism: De Novo Cryptic Splice Site Activation (Deep Intronic)
molecular_evaluation.impact_details: Located 4105 bp into the intron, standard distance heuristics score this 0.0002. AlphaGenome's 100 kb sequence backbone identifies de novo 5' donor site generation (delta 0.6522), activating an out-of-frame pseudoexon insertion that disrupts the BRCA1 mRNA open reading frame.
molecular_evaluation.exon_intron_location: Intron 10 (4,105 base pairs downstream of Exon 10 donor site)

benchmark_evaluation.baseline_comparison: Baseline distance heuristic (1/distance = 0.00024) fails because the variant is 4105 bp deep in the intron. AlphaGenome's intronic ROC AUC (0.993) substantially outperforms the distance baseline (0.914), capturing this deep-intronic defect.
benchmark_evaluation.benchmark_validation_stat: 49 of 68 benchmark variants in this bin were experimentally splice-altering

acmg_codes.rule: SpliceVarDB experimental catalogue notes splicing involvement.
AlphaGenome score 0.950 indicates deep-intronic cryptic activation (Bin 4: 72.1% empirical PPV).

clinical_management.clinical_directive: ACTION: Prioritize patient blood/tissue sample for expedited RNA-seq minigene functional validation. While current evidence supports 72.1% PPV, standalone clinical reclassification to Pathogenic requires transcriptional confirmation of pseudoexon inclusion. Maintain close clinical surveillance based on family pedigree while functional assay is pending.
clinical_management.tumor_board_summary: High Priority Laboratory Escalation: Expedite functional RNA minigene assay. Maintain proactive clinical surveillance.

literature_evidence.citation: SpliceVarDB Consortium. (2024). SpliceVarDB: A comprehensive database of experimentally validated human splicing variants.
literature_evidence.clinical_takeaway: SpliceVarDB catalogues this deep-intronic substitution as an active splice-altering variant identified via targeted transcript sequencing.

literature_evidence.citation: Fraile-Bethencourt, E., et al. (2019). De novo cryptic splice site activation in deep intronic regions of cancer predisposition genes.
literature_evidence.clinical_takeaway: Deep intronic SNVs in BRCA1 can generate high-affinity 5' donor motifs that incorporate out-of-frame pseudoexons, causing loss of tumor suppressor function.

literature_evidence.citation: Avsec, Ž., et al. (2026). Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome.
literature_evidence.clinical_takeaway: AlphaGenome's long context window flags this variant with high delta (0.652 site delta), outperforming standard distance tools (ROC AUC 0.993 vs. 0.914).
